provenance.note: Pages are hand-authored in an AI-typical idiom, NOT emitted by a model. No hosted model was called (no-paid-API constraint). Each page records the brief it implements so the study can be repeated against real model output using the same 30 prompts. This is the study's primary external-validity limitation.
provenance.deterministic: no Math.random, no Date, no timers, no animation, no network
